notes.session_conflict: TipRanks lists the session as 'After Close' and MarketBeat labels the date 'estimated'. Both are contradicted by the company press release of 2026-08-25 and by Finviz ('Sep 08 BMO'). Company source treated as controlling.
notes.implied_move_confidence: Low-to-medium. ABM's option book is thin: the Sep-18 45-strike call is quoted 2.70/3.40 (23% wide) and the 50-strike call 0.15/1.15. Marking the K=45 straddle to the bid gives 6.9% and to the ask 9.9%. The 8.4% point estimate comes from decomposing 49.0% front-month ATM IV over 9 trading sessions (Sep 7 is Labor Day) against an 18.7% RV30 baseline; alternative IV inputs give 7.8%-8.6%.
notes.historical_moves_basis: Close-to-close, computed by me from the Yahoo daily OHLC JSON API. Listed array is the last six events: 2025-03-12, 2025-06-06, 2025-09-05, 2025-12-17, 2026-03-10, 2026-06-05. Split 3 up / 3 down. Last eight events: mean_abs 5.42, median_abs 6.08, 4 up / 4 down.
notes.reaction_function: Three of the last four adjusted-EPS misses produced flat-to-up sessions (-13.7% surprise gave +0.33%, -19.3% gave +5.49%, -2.2% gave +6.67%). The one large down day (2026-03-10, -4.62%) came with a small EPS miss but broad segment-margin compression and a guidance midpoint below consensus. The market trades the guide and the margin trajectory, not the headline.
notes.magnitude_view: Implied 8.4% exceeds the last-six realised mean of 5.81% and median of 6.08%; front-month IV of 49.0% is ~1.95x computed RV30 of 18.7%. If there is an edge in this name it is more likely in the event premium than in the direction.
notes.positioning: Not crowded either way. Short interest ~3.2-3.3% of float and falling, borrow fee <0.35%, put/call OI 0.137. MarketBeat consensus price target of $47.00 sits at the $47.05 spot with 1 Buy / 4 Hold; three of four named analysts have targets at or below spot.
notes.key_tail_risk: An unexpected prior-year self-insurance adjustment. Q4 FY25 carried $(22.2)M pre-tax / $(0.26) per share, which is why that quarter missed by 19.3%. The Q2 FY26 10-Q states the review found no adjustment required, and its language implies a Q2/Q4 cadence — so I judge Q3 the lower-risk quarter for this item, but it is an inference from filing language, not confirmed policy.
notes.underappreciated_positive: The FY26 adjusted-EPS definition tightened mid-year. The original guidance (2025-12-17) was $3.85-$4.15 EXCLUDING prior-year self-insurance adjustments; the Q2 reaffirmation of the same numeric range NO LONGER excludes them. Holding the range constant on a stricter definition is an implicit raise.
notes.underappreciated_negative: H1 EPS was carried by buying back 2.13M shares (~3.6% of shares out) for $94.1M. Only $89.0M of authorisation remains and management has named debt repayment the near-term priority, so that tailwind largely disappears in H2 while the margin ramp has to carry the whole guide.
notes.recovered_via: Price history from the Yahoo chart JSON API and options from the CBOE delayed-quotes JSON API; both returned successfully and are the basis for every computed figure.
